title: Foacraft Campfire 营火工艺
description: A Chinese MMORPG server with a unique world setting, free gear crafting, and the freedom to forge your own weapon spirits. Explore islands across multiple dimensions and battle fierce monsters on your adventure.
body:
# 🔥 Tired of the same old survival mode?

Are you looking for a **real adventure** in a world full of **depth, progression, and challenge**?

Welcome to **Foacraft Campfire** — a **Minecraft 1.20.1 vanilla RPG server** built for true RPG players.  
Here, you can ignite your spirit of adventure and forge your own legend. ⚔️

---

## ✨ Server Features

### 🛡️ Deep RPG System
Say goodbye to simple mob grinding and basic leveling.  
Our server features a detailed stat system, including **Physical Damage, Magic Power, Critical Strike, Armor Penetration**, and more.  
You will need to build your gear and choose your skills carefully in order to defeat powerful enemies.

### 🔨 Free Forging System
Become a true forging master.  
There are no boring fixed recipes here. Instead, you can freely combine different materials to craft **one-of-a-kind weapons and equipment** with endless possibilities.

### 🗺️ Rich Exploration Content
From peaceful islands to dangerous unknown continents, a vast world is waiting for you to discover.  
Find hidden treasures, challenge powerful world bosses, and uncover stories buried in history.

### 🚀 Constant Updates
Our development team will continue to deliver **new content, new challenges, and new stories**, making sure your adventure always feels fresh and rewarding.

---

## 📖 Gameplay Overview

### 1️⃣ Choose Your Own Path
There are **no fixed classes** in the game.  
Your combat style depends on the weapon you choose — such as **longswords, staffs, greataxes**, and more.  
You can switch weapons freely and experience different playstyles whenever you want.

### 2️⃣ Explore and Gather
The world is filled with unique materials and valuable resources.  
By defeating monsters, opening chests, and exploring hidden areas, you can collect everything you need for forging.

### 3️⃣ Forge Legendary Equipment
Take the materials you gather and visit the forging masters in **Foacraft Campfire**.  
By combining materials freely, you can create powerful equipment with **randomized attributes** and **unique skills**.  
Every forging attempt is a brand-new possibility. ✨

### 4️⃣ Challenge and Grow
Join public events across the world, challenge powerful regional lords and world bosses, and team up with other players to claim rare loot and glory.  
Your journey will be filled with danger, rewards, and unforgettable battles. 🐉

---

# 🌐 INTERNATIONAL PLAYERS NOTICE

## 🚧 English localization is currently in progress
We are currently working on **internationalization and translation** for **Foacraft Campfire**.  
Some content may still be partially untranslated or under active localization.

### 📢 Join our Discord for the latest updates
If you are interested in the server, please join our Discord to learn more about:
- current translation progress
- international player support
- upcoming updates and announcements
- community details and server access

## 🔥 Begin Your Adventure
If you are searching for a Minecraft server with **true RPG depth**, **freeform progression**, and a world worth exploring,  
then **Foacraft Campfire** is waiting for you.

**Light the fire. Forge your legend.** 🔥
